Question 13
?

Find the function f(x) and the value of b, given that ∫0bf(x)dx=limn→∞∑k=0n−1[sin⁡(2kn)⋅2n].

a
f(x)=2sin⁡2x and b=2
b
f(x)=sin⁡x and b=1
c
f(x)=sin⁡2x and b=2
d
f(x)=sin⁡x and b=2
e
f(x)=sin⁡2x and b=1
